title: Deploy once per release
summary: Agents now check for a deploy that is already queued or running, and for the live site already serving the release, before starting a Cloudron deploy, so each release is activated once.
changes: Check for a queued or running Cloudron deploy, and for live health already reporting the version and commit, before dispatching a deploy.
Record that a GitHub Release creation date is the commit date, and that its publish date shows when it was made.
Record the Windows PowerShell quoting trap with GitHub CLI arguments and filters.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.39 line: agent documentation only, with no application behaviour change.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the pull request branch.
Version-pinned release history tests updated for the new head record.
known_limitations: The check is a documented step for agents. The deploy workflow itself still accepts a second dispatch and queues it.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Documentation changes do not alter runtime application behaviour.
